claims.quote: CACNA2D2 knockout mice have spontaneous seizures and increased PTZ seizure susceptibility.

claims.object_text: Decreased CACNA2D2 mRNA in mice that lacked TSP1
claims.quote: Decreased CACNA2D2 mRNA was only detected in mice that lacked TSP1

claims.object_text: low CACNA2D2 mRNA expression associated with increased seizure susceptibility in TSP1 and TSP1/2 KO mice
claims.quote: Here we report similar findings, TSP1, and TSP1/2 KO mice have low levels of CACNA2D2 mRNA expression and α2δ-1/2 receptor level in the cortex, and are more susceptible to seizures.

claims.object_text: TSP1 may control CACNA2D2 levels and modify seizure susceptibility
claims.quote: Our data suggest TSP1 in particular may control CACNA2D2 levels and could be a modifier of seizure susceptibility.
CACNA2D2 mutations in mice and humans can cause epilepsy.
